name: Simple_Price_EA
summary: Simple_Price_EA is a breakout-style expert advisor that monitors price levels and enters trades when price breaks through predefined support or resistance thresholds. It uses fixed stop loss and take profit levels with optional trailing stop functionality. The EA is designed for straightforward price action trading without complex indicator dependencies.
summary_zh: Simple_Price_EA是一个突破类EA，监控价格水平并在价格突破预设支撑或阻力阈值时进场交易。它使用固定的止损和止盈水平，并带有可选的移动止损功能。该EA专为直接的价格行为交易设计，不依赖复杂指标。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于价格突破的简单交易系统，当价格突破预设的关键价位时进场做多或做空。入场条件为价格突破上方阈值时开多单，价格突破下方阈值时开空单。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈，以及可选的移动止损来锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额动态调整的机制。资金管理方面较为基础，缺少最大回撤控制或风险比例计算功能。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合初学者理解，但在复杂市场环境下可能表现不佳。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a simple price breakout trading system that enters long positions when price breaks above a predefined upper threshold and short positions when price breaks below a lower threshold. Entry conditions are based purely on price level breaches without confirmation from additional indicators, which can lead to false breakout entries. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, along with an optional trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits as the trade moves favorably. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management is relatively basic, lacking features such as maximum drawdown control, equity protection, or proportional risk sizing. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and easy to understand, but may underperform in choppy or ranging markets where false breakouts are common.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA唯一标识符，区分不同实例
parameters.description_en: EA unique identifier for instance differentiation

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
基于价格突破，无需复杂指标计算，执行速度快
支持移动止损功能，可以有效锁定浮动利润
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and debug
Based on price breakout without complex indicator calculations, ensuring fast execution
Supports trailing stop functionality to effectively lock in floating profits
cons: 缺少突破确认机制，容易受假突破影响产生亏损交易
固定手数方式不灵活，未根据账户风险动态调整仓位
缺少多时间框架过滤和趋势过滤，在震荡市中表现可能较差
cons_en: Lacks breakout confirmation mechanism, vulnerable to false breakouts that generate losing trades
Fixed lot sizing is inflexible, does not dynamically adjust position based on account risk
Lacks multi-timeframe filtering and trend filtering, may underperform in ranging markets
improvements: 增加成交量或波动率确认机制来过滤假突破
引入基于账户权益的动态仓位计算，实现更合理的资金管理
添加多时间框架趋势过滤，只在主趋势方向上交易突破信号
improvements_en: Add volume or volatility confirmation mechanism to filter false breakouts
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account equity for more rational money management
Add multi-timeframe trend filtering to only trade breakout signals in the direction of the main trend

risk_points: 缺少假突破过滤机制，可能在震荡行情中频繁止损
固定手数未与账户规模挂钩，小账户可能过度承担风险
未检测是否有同方向已有持仓，可能导致重复开仓
risk_points_en: Lacks false breakout filtering, may trigger frequent stop losses in choppy markets
Fixed lot size not linked to account size, small accounts may take excessive risk
Does not check for existing positions in same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries
